title: Chalk Dust Club
description: I created a series of custom climbing shirts for friends within the community, designed as one of a kind tributes to their personal journeys. The front of each shirt features a stylized portrait in my signature drawing style, while the back showcases a custom illustration of a climb that holds significant meaning or represents a personal milestone for them. Each piece is a unique blend of character design and environmental storytelling, tailored to the individual climber.
